_note: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.164(2) – (3), (12) (Gazette 271092 pp.1662 – 1664), for the tax year commencing 1 April 2026 only (r.164(1), (14)). Positive conditions, all of which hold: a resident other than not ordinarily resident; total income under (a) – (d) only, so no business income (D-523 C5a); (b) "does not own more than two house property and does not have any brought forward loss or loss to be carried forward under the head", the limit holding whether or not the head's income is nil (D-529 C3a); (c) "does not have any loss under the head" — its exception, "except winnings from lottery or income from race horses", is unwritten because the engine computes neither (OtherSourceKind.WINNINGS is refused; no input carries race-horse income) and is W-261 (D-529 C2a); (d) "only long-term capital gains under section 198 not exceeding ₹ 125000" — the LONG_TERM_LISTED_EQUITY part (CG-PART-LONG-LISTED, s.198(1)) — and no loss brought forward or to be carried forward. Bars r.164(3)(a) – (n): eleven clauses are the year's declarations ((i) is two), (e) the s.93 rows other than the family-pension (1)(d) rows, (k) total income as rounded under s.516. Furnishing: Table Sl. 3's three manners, and Sl. 4's paper form for an individual of eighty years or more at any time during the tax year; Sl. 2 (accounts audited under s.63) reaches only a person carrying on business, whom this form does not serve.
